artists.biography: Benjamin Scott "Ben" Folds (born September 12, 1966) is an American singer-songwriter and record producer. From 1995 to 2000, Folds was the frontman and pianist of the alternative rock band Ben Folds Five. After the group temporarily disbanded, Folds performed as a solo artist and has toured all over the world. The group reunited in 2011. He has also collaborated with musicians such as William Shatner, Regina Spektor and "Weird Al" Yankovic and undertaken experimental songwriting projects with authors such as Nick Hornby and Neil Gaiman. In addition to contributing music to the soundtracks of the animated films Over the Hedge, and Hoodwinked!, Folds produced Amanda Palmer's first solo album and has been a judge on the NBC a cappella singing contest The Sing-Off since 2009.
artists.name: Ben Folds

artists.biography: The National Symphony Orchestra (NSO) is an American symphony orchestra based in Washington, D.C. Founded in 1930 by cellist Hans Kindler, its principal performing venue is the John F. Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts.

perplexity.description:
Ben Folds' Live With The National Symphony Orchestra, released on July 4, 2025, is a genre-blending live album that showcases the singer-songwriter’s signature piano-driven rock anthems and introspective ballads reimagined with the lush arrangements of the National Symphony Orchestra. Recorded over two sold-out nights at the Kennedy Center in Washington, D.C., the album features both classic hits and new material, conducted by Steven Reineke and augmented by special guests Regina Spektor and Tall Heights. The orchestral setting elevates Folds’ pop sensibilities, merging rock energy with classical grandeur and highlighting his skill as a composer and performer.

This release marks a significant moment in Ben Folds’ discography, following his acclaimed 2023 pop album and 2024 holiday record. It continues his exploration of orchestral collaboration, building on his previous success with the Concerto for Piano and Orchestra. The album’s blend of rock and classical elements reflects Folds’ reputation as a genre-bending artist, bridging audiences across musical worlds. While specific critical reviews are not yet widely published, the album’s release was met with enthusiasm, supported by a high-profile tour and exclusive high-resolution audio formats, underscoring its commercial and artistic ambition.
